description: On a new space (today_summary.first_run), offer this first and call it on any yes: once right after you connect, and again once the person's first account connects. Does every setup step it can: posting times (suggested from the account's numbers, else its network's busiest hours), the history import and draft link page the connect follow-up makes (queued again when it didn't run; the page stays offline until they publish it), and the first post: a copy of their best recent video for a network that hasn't had it (copied from Instagram when they posted it there), sent for approval. Hands you their best captions to learn the voice from (save it with voice_set without asking) and accounts to suggest watching. done is what to tell them in one short message; for_you is what you do next without asking; needs_person is the one thing only they can do, with its link. Nothing is published: a person approves every post. Calling it again only does what's left.

first_post.description: Make the first post when it's a copy of a video they already posted (sent for approval). false: only suggest it

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

link_page.description: Build a draft link page when there isn't one (it stays offline)

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: setup_run
title: Set up the space
